questions.question: NLI 为一个 (premise, hypothesis) 对分配哪三个标签？
questions.explanation: NLI 是在 entailment（蕴含）、contradiction（矛盾）和 neutral（中立）上的三分类。

questions.question: NLI 如何被用作 zero-shot（零样本）文本分类器？
options: Verbalize each candidate label as a hypothesis (e.g. 'This text is about sports') and pick the label with the highest entailment score
questions.explanation: NLI-as-classifier 将标签转化为假设；模型选择最大 entailment（蕴含）分数的标签。

questions.question: 为什么 NLI 是 RAG 输出的忠实度（faithfulness）检查？
options: Checking whether the retrieved context entails each answer claim is exactly the formulation NLI was trained on
questions.explanation: 幻觉（Hallucination）= 答案主张未被检索到的上下文所蕴含；NLI 直接度量蕴含关系。

questions.question: hypothesis-only 基线暴露了什么问题？
options: Datasets where the hypothesis alone (without the premise) is predictive of the label, signalling label leakage
questions.explanation: SNLI 上较高的 hypothesis-only 分数揭示了标注伪影（annotation artifacts）；可用于调试数据。

questions.question: 哪个 NLI 模型家族在 2026 年的排行榜上位居榜首，是标准的主力模型？
questions.explanation: DeBERTa-v3 在 MNLI 和相关语料上 fine-tuned（微调）后，是 2026 年开源 NLI 的主力模型。

questions.question: 为什么句子级 NLI 模型在文档长度前提上的准确率会下降？
options: They were trained on short premises and fail at multi-sentence and multi-hop inference; DocNLI-tuned models handle longer inputs
questions.explanation: 训练分布不匹配：单句 NLI 模型在文档长度输入上损失 20+ F1。

questions.question: 为什么 zero-shot 准确率会因假设模板不同而波动 10+ 个百分点？
options: Models are sensitive to phrasing; e.g. 'This text is about {label}' vs '{label}' alone shifts entailment probabilities
questions.explanation: 模板措辞会实质性地改变蕴含分数；请在一个小的 held-out 集上调优。

questions.question: 关于 NLI 用于幻觉检测，可以安全地做出什么断言？
options: It reduces hallucination as a faithfulness signal but does not eliminate it; combine with retrieval recall and human review
questions.explanation: NLI 是一个有用的信号，但不是完整的解决方案；需与检索指标和人工抽查结合使用。
